name_en: UNCCD PRAIS4 / Data Dashboard: Armenia national reporting rasters (SDG 15.3.1 status, LDN, drought, population exposure)
description_en: The UNCCD Data Dashboard API lists five raster layers for Armenia, all imported on 2023-02-01 with origin code TE_IMPORT (interpreted as a Trends.Earth import): SDG_STATUS_REPORTING, LDN_REPORTING, LAND_DROUGHT_E5, TOTAL_POPULATION_EXPOSED_TO_LAND_DEGRADATION_REPORTING and TOTAL_POPULATION_EXPOSED_TO_DROUGHT_E5. Each is served as an OGC WMS (MapServer 7.6.7, 'PRAIS4 WMS Server'; GetMap formats include image/png and image/tiff) with a bounding box of lon 43.45-46.6375, lat 38.835-41.3.
producer: UNCCD secretariat (PRAIS4 platform); content submitted by Armenia (country record shows submitted_report = 'national')
year_or_period: Import dated 2023-02-01; the API lists a baseline_period and a reporting_period but does not state the years. SDG 15.3.1 values for 2015 and 2019 are published on sdg.armstat.am.
resolution: Not stated in the WMS metadata
direct_download_or_service: Layer list: https://data.unccd.int/api/countries/ARM/rasters/ . WMS GetCapabilities pattern: https://data.unccd.int/api/countries/ARM/rasters/{id}/mapserver/?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities with id 98o2g6Y (LDN_REPORTING), 0EQpov0 (SDG_STATUS_REPORTING), rLRKzQ9 (LAND_DROUGHT_E5), r6L2qp9 (population exposed to land degradation), 9l6J78r (population exposed to drought). Underlying endpoint: https://reporting.unccd.int:80/cgi-bin/mapserv.exe?map=/mapserver/ARM/LDN_REPORTING/2023-02-01-te-AP9Y0QP/layer.map&
gap_or_issue: No licence stated for Armenia (the UNCCD spatial-layers-licenses API lists 7 countries, Armenia not among them). Resolution and class legend must be read from the legend endpoint / UNCCD Good Practice Guidance. Reflects default global data unless Armenia replaced it with national data; this was not checked. Several Armenian sources quote very different degradation shares (e.g. an Environment Ministry official said 86% in 2021 without a method), so use these rasters only as a first screening layer.
usable_for: First-pass screening of improving / stable / degrading land and of population exposed to degradation and drought; overlay with project locations to see where donors work in degrading areas.

name_en: SDG 15.3.1 - proportion of land that is degraded, Armenia (national statistics table)
description_en: The Armstat SDG platform (Open SDG) shows indicator 15.3.1 for Armenia as 19.28% for 2015 and 19.44% for 2019, sourced from the UN Statistics Division (custodian UNCCD). Headline, source and disaggregation CSVs plus a PNG chart can be downloaded from the indicator page; data last updated 2026-02-05.
producer: Statistical Committee of Armenia (Armstat) / UN Statistics Division / UNCCD
project_or_programme: Armenia SDG national reporting platform (Open SDG)
direct_download_or_service: Indicator CSVs linked on the page; all-indicator ZIP (601 KB, HTTP 200): https://armstat.github.io/sdg-data-armenia/prod/en/zip/all_indicators.zip
gap_or_issue: Only two national percentages; no marz, community or map breakdown. Not consistent with the 86% degraded / 44% desertified figures quoted by an Environment Ministry official in April 2021 (no method or map given) - the two numbers use different definitions and should not be mixed. Platform is labelled Alpha. Licence not stated on the page.
usable_for: Headline national baseline for LDN monitoring and for citing SDG 15.3 progress; not usable for targeting communities.

name_en: FAO-GEF LDN project maps for Lori and Syunik (SDG 15.3.1 sub-indicators: land cover, land productivity, SOC)
description_en: GEF project 10365 'Implementation of Armenia's LDN commitments through SLM and restoration of degraded landscapes' (FAO, executed with the Ministry of Environment; pilot sites Tumanyan community in Lori and Gorayk community in Syunik) plans LDN indicator maps for Lori and Syunik under ProDoc Output 1.2.2 (Trends.Earth and Collect Earth). The ProDoc baseline states that no LDN assessment or maps existed for Lori and Syunik and lists the national and community maps used to prepare it.
producer: FAO (GEF agency) with Ministry of Environment / Environmental Projects Implementation Unit
year_or_period: Approved 2021-09-16; ProDoc period 2021-10-01 to 2024-10-01; GEF page lists 2026 PIR
gap_or_issue: No public download or viewer found. Per an internal status note of 2026-11-04 the Output 1.2.2 maps are still in preparation; the LDN decision-support system (Output 1.3.3) and the monitoring system (Output 1.2.3) were not yet built. ProDoc baseline products (ESA 300 m land cover 2015, MODIS NDVI productivity 2000-2018, SOC 2018 and SOC trend 2001-2018, FIRMS fire maps 2019, community-level land degradation trend maps for Lori, Syunik, Tumanyan, Gorayq) are described in the document, but the files were not located online. ProDoc itself says the 300 m land cover is insufficient for Armenia.
usable_for: Community-level LDN baseline for the two pilot marzes once released; ask the Ministry of Environment / EPIU / FAO Armenia for the files and for the Trends.Earth project folder.

name_en: Armenia LDN Target Setting Programme report and UNCCD voluntary LDN targets
description_en: The UNCCD data API records 3 voluntary LDN targets for Armenia (3 'ongoing', 0 'achieved'). The FAO-GEF ProDoc quotes Armenia's LDN Target Setting Report national goal: 'By the year 2040, the carbon stock lost between 2000 and 2010 will be recovered and increased by 2.8% in relation to present', supported by four targets: (1) arrest cropland degradation and promote agro-ecology, (2) afforest and/or reforest two thirds of the degraded land, (3) arrest deforestation and improve forest management on 100% of the national territory, (4) arrest overgrazing and improve grassland management (target 4 wording is cut off in the extracted ProDoc text).
producer: Ministry of Environment of Armenia with UNCCD Global Mechanism (LDN Target Setting Programme)
direct_download_or_service: https://data.unccd.int/api/countries/ARM/voluntary-targets/ (JSON summary: total 3, achieved 0, ongoing 3)
gap_or_issue: The Target Setting report PDF itself was not located (unccd.int returned 403 to automated access; a 2015 'Armenia LDN National Report' is listed on Land Portal but that page also returned 403). No spatial target layer found. Details of the three targets are not in the API summary.
usable_for: Aligning donor programmes with the national LDN goal (carbon stock recovery by 2040).

name_en: ARMSIS Soil Map of Armenia (1:100,000) and soil property rasters / profile database
description_en: Armenian Soil Information System (ArmSIS, built with FAO, Global Soil Partnership, ANAU, Centre of the Agricultural Services SNCO and the Institute of Geological Sciences) catalogue entries: a 1:100,000 Soil Map (Armenian classification, mapped 2005, sampling 1953-1967, authors Melkonian, Parsadanian, Edilian; provider: Scientific Center of Soil Sciences, Agrochemistry and Melioration after H. Petrossyan, ANAU), plus soil pH, clay, silt, sand, bulk density, CEC rasters and soil profile database tables (site and horizon). A coarser 1:750,000 Soils of Armenia vector layer from the SCOPES 'Sustainable Caucasus' project is also catalogued.
producer: Armenian National Agrarian University (ANAU) Scientific Center of Soil Sciences; ArmSIS partners
project_or_programme: ArmSIS (FAO / GSP / ANAU / SNCO / Institute of Geological Sciences)
direct_download_or_service: Catalogued as http://armsis.cas.am/download/44 (soil map), /download/46 and /download/45 (profile site / horizon) and WFS/WMS on http://armsis.cas.am/geoserver/ows - host did not resolve on 2026-11-04. UNEP GRID 1:750,000 soils: https://sustainable-caucasus.unepgrid.ch/download/78 (returned 404 on 2026-11-04)
gap_or_issue: The ArmSIS GeoNode host (armsis.cas.am) did not resolve from our network on 2026-11-04 and the UNEP GRID mirror was 'Under maintenance' with download links returning 404, so the files are currently not retrievable by us; the Open Data Armenia entries (harvested 2023-07-08) only point to those hosts. Soil sampling is 1953-1967, so properties pre-date recent degradation. No licence stated. Ask ANAU / SNCO (contacts in the catalogue entries) for a copy.
usable_for: National soil type and property baseline for land-suitability, erosion and SLM targeting; overlay with salinity and SOC.

name_en: ARMSIS digital soil maps of electrical conductivity (salinity) and exchangeable sodium percentage
description_en: Two digital soil mapping rasters in ArmSIS: 'Soil electric conductivity' (dS/m, calculated from total salts; Quantile Regression Forest; RMSE 0.64; mean error 0) and 'Exchangeable Sodium Percent' (ESP = Na(exch)/CEC x 100; QRF; RMSE 2.03; mean error -0.04), each with a 90% confidence-interval uncertainty map. Input samples are from 1953-1967; maps were produced in October 2020 (catalogue dates '23-10-20' and '26-10-20').
producer: Centre of the Agricultural Services SNCO; Scientific Center of Soil Sciences, Agrochemistry and Melioration after H. Petrossyan, ANAU
direct_download_or_service: Catalogued as http://armsis.cas.am/download/32 (EC) and /download/33 (ESP), GeoTIFF - host did not resolve on 2026-11-04
gap_or_issue: Not retrievable at present (ArmSIS host unreachable). Salinity reflects 1953-1967 sampling, i.e. not current; Ararat Valley salinity has since changed. Extent of the rasters (national or Ararat Valley only) is not stated in the catalogue entry. No licence stated. No salinity class thresholds given.
usable_for: Only national-scale digital salinity/sodicity surfaces found; usable as a historical baseline for locating salt-affected land in Ararat, Armavir, Vayots Dzor.

name_en: SoilGrids (ISRIC) global soil property maps, 250 m
description_en: ISRIC SoilGrids provides global 250 m maps of soil properties (pH, organic carbon content and stock, bulk density, coarse fragments, sand, silt, clay, CEC, total nitrogen and others) at six standard depths, free under CC BY 4.0. The files tree at files.isric.org serves VRT/GeoTIFF mosaics (e.g. ocs/ocs_0-30cm_mean.vrt, soc/soc_0-5cm_mean.vrt, phh2o/phh2o_0-5cm_mean.vrt all responded HTTP 200).

name_en: Harmonized World Soil Database v2.0 (FAO/IIASA)
description_en: HWSD v2.0 is a 1 km (30 arc-second) global soil raster with seven depth layers (0-20 to 150-200 cm) and attribute tables (e.g. effective CEC, total nitrogen, C/N ratio, USDA texture class, bulk density, rootable depth, available water capacity). The raster (22.4 MB zip) and Access database are downloadable without login.
producer: FAO and IIASA
direct_download_or_service: Raster: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/data.gaezdev.aws.fao.org/HWSD/HWSD2_RASTER.zip (HTTP 200, 22.4 MB); database: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/data.gaezdev.aws.fao.org/HWSD/HWSD2_DB.zip

name_en: FAO Global Map of Salt-affected Soils (GSASmap v1.0)
description_en: GSASmap v1.0 (2021) is the Global Soil Partnership's global map of salt-affected soils compiled from national contributions (118 countries, 257,419 locations with measured data) for 0-30 and 30-100 cm. The FAO page states that the EURASIA and NENA regions could not prepare maps because of data challenges.
producer: FAO Global Soil Partnership
gap_or_issue: Armenia is not mentioned on the FAO page and, given the regional statement above, probably has no national contribution - unconfirmed. Page gives no resolution, licence or direct download link (links to a data platform).
usable_for: If Armenian coverage exists it would be the only internationally harmonised salinity layer; otherwise treat as a gap.

name_en: Ararat Valley soil salinity studies (YSU 2023-24 sampling, Landsat-8 mapping, YSU thematic-map project)
description_en: Published studies on Ararat Plain salinity: Margaryan (YSU, 2024) sampled 66 farmland sites in Armavir and Baghramyan regions at the end of the 2023 irrigation season and found soluble-salt build-up in upper horizons (the paper also cites about 30,000 ha of salinised soil); a YSU grant project 21AG-4C075 (2021-10-01 to 2026-09-30, 156 million AMD) aims to produce thematic salinisation-degree and irrigation-water-quality (IWQI) maps; a Landsat-8 mapping paper (Starodubtsev and Bogdanets, 2018) is reported in its index abstract to put saline soils at about 21,503 ha (28.7%) of the southern Ararat Valley.
producer: Yerevan State University; NUBiP Ukraine (Landsat-8 study)
project_or_programme: YSU grant 21AG-4C075 (funder not named on page)
resolution: point samples; 30 m Landsat-8 in 2018 study
gap_or_issue: No published salinity map or GIS layer found: the YSU project page lists maps only as objectives, the 2024 paper provides a sampling-points figure, and the 2018 article page could not be opened (figures taken from a search-result abstract). Contact YSU (Chair of Ecology and Nature Conservation) for sample data and the project maps.
usable_for: Evidence on salinity extent and hotspots in Armavir / Ararat for targeting reclamation and drainage investments.

name_en: ESA WorldCover 10 m land cover (2020 v100, 2021 v200)
description_en: Global 11-class land cover map at 10 m from Sentinel-1/2 for 2020 (v100) and 2021 (v200), free under CC BY 4.0. Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF 3x3 degree tiles are openly downloadable from AWS S3; the tiles needed for Armenia are N39E042, N39E045 and N36E045 (southern tip of Syunik), each HTTP 200 and about 74-102 MB.
producer: ESA / VITO and WorldCover consortium
direct_download_or_service: s3://esa-worldcover/v200/2021/map/ (no sign-in), e.g. https://esa-worldcover.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/v200/2021/map/ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N39E045_Map.tif ; GEE: ESA/WorldCover/v100 and ESA/WorldCover/v200
gap_or_issue: Generic global classes (grassland / cropland only; no pasture, hayfield or orchard distinction) and only two years, so not suitable for change detection. The WSL FORACCA comparison found the four 10 m products (including WorldCover) agree on about 4,000 km2 of tree cover in 2020.
usable_for: Current land cover base map and cropland/grassland/tree area statistics per community.

name_en: Hansen / UMD Global Forest Change 2000-2025 (v1.13)
description_en: 30 m global tree cover in 2000, forest loss by year to 2025, gain 2000-2012, free under CC BY 4.0. Tile GeoTIFFs for Armenia (40N_040E and 50N_040E) respond HTTP 200 on Google Cloud Storage; also on Earth Engine as UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2025_v1_13.
producer: University of Maryland / Hansen et al. with Google

name_en: FORACCA Sentinel-2 Vegetation Height Model for Armenia, 2017-2025 (WSL)
description_en: Countrywide annual 10 m maximum vegetation height models for Armenia produced by WSL (CNN trained on Swiss lidar) within the SDC-funded FORACCA project; nine GeoTIFFs 2017-2025 (about 2.8-3.2 GB each). The accompanying WSL report (Nov 2025) compared seven global land cover products 1992-2024 and found about 4,000 km2 of tree cover in 2020, no significant change 2017-2025.
producer: Swiss Federal Institute WSL (Rüetschi, Ginzler) with Zoi Environment Network and Forest Alliance of Armenia
project_or_programme: FORACCA - Forest Restoration and Climate Change in Armenia (SDC)
direct_download_or_service: Files via https://www.envidat.ch/dataset/d5dd3a3d-093e-4206-9e0b-76c6f21c9be1/resource/f1b1e699-6f6c-4bb0-89f6-89d8c455c5a2/download/s2-vhm_2025_max.tif (redirects to a time-limited S3 link; ranged GET returned 206, no login). DOI 10.16904/envidat.690

usable_for: Best current open, Armenia-specific basis for a forest/tree-cover mask, height classes and change screening; fills the gap left by the missing national forest inventory.

gap_or_issue: No published plot data, forest area/stock figures or forest map found; availability and data-sharing terms unknown. The fact sheet does not give plot counts (a search result reported 264 plots surveyed by May 2025, not verified on the page).
usable_for: Will be the first updated national forest inventory since 1993; ask FAO Armenia / EPIU / Ministry of Environment for the Collect Earth land-category results and plot design.

sources.title: FAO Armenia fact sheet - Forest Resilience of Armenia (Oct 2025)

name_en: Hayantar State Forest Inventory / official forest fund data (last full inventory 1993)
description_en: The official state forest inventory records the forest fund managed by Hayantar. The World Bank's 2023 Armenia Forest Landscape Restoration Note states that official forest cover data rest on the last inventory done in 1993 and that forested-area estimates range from 249,000 ha to 334,100 ha (official forest area quoted as 328,470 ha); a 2005 feasibility study for a new national forest inventory was not carried out. The WSL FORACCA project says no full inventory has been done since 1989.
producer: Hayantar SNCO / Ministry of Environment
gap_or_issue: No public GIS of forest enterprise / forest stand boundaries found; hayantar.am returns a self-signed certificate error and forest.am returns 403 to automated access. Figures are old and contradictory; many state-designated forests may no longer be forest and vice versa (FORACCA).
usable_for: Official forest fund boundaries needed to attribute reforestation and forest-protection programmes to forest enterprises and communities; must be requested from Hayantar / Ministry of Environment.

sources.title: World Bank - Armenia Forest Landscape Restoration Note (June 2023)

name_en: CHIRPS daily / monthly precipitation (UCSB Climate Hazards Center)
description_en: Quasi-global rainfall from 1981 combining satellite imagery and station data at 0.05 degrees (about 5.6 km), public domain. Daily collection UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY on Earth Engine runs 1981-01-01 to 2026-09-30; CHC also serves CHIRPS v3.0 monthly GeoTIFFs.
producer: UCSB Climate Hazards Center
license: Public domain (copyright waived, per GEE page)
direct_download_or_service: GEE asset UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY; v3.0 monthly directory https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS/v3.0/monthly/global/tifs/ (HTTP 200, listing not inspected)
gap_or_issue: 5.6 km pixels are too coarse for Armenia's relief (gradients over a few km); station coverage in Armenia unknown. The older v2.0 path tried at data.chc.ucsb.edu returned 404.
usable_for: Rainfall totals, drought anomalies and trends per marz / large community.

name_en: ERA5-Land monthly reanalysis (Copernicus C3S)
description_en: Global land surface reanalysis (temperature, precipitation, soil moisture, evaporation and more) at 0.1 degrees (about 11 km), 1950 to within three months of real time; Earth Engine asset ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR (available to 2026-09-01). Copernicus licence requires the attribution 'Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service Information [year]'.
producer: ECMWF / Copernicus Climate Change Service
direct_download_or_service: GEE asset ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY_AGGR (the CDS API route needs a free Copernicus account)
gap_or_issue: 11 km grid, coarse for mountain terrain; reanalysis, not station observations. The FORACCA/Armhydromet climate indicators use a 1991-2020 reanalysis as their baseline.
usable_for: Long-term temperature and soil-moisture baselines and trends; drought and heat indicators.

name_en: WorldClim 2.1 climate surfaces (1970-2000) and CMIP6 future projections
description_en: Monthly min/mean/max temperature, precipitation, solar radiation, wind, vapour pressure and 19 bioclimatic variables, averaged 1970-2000, at 30 arc-seconds (~1 km) to 10 arc-minutes. Direct zip download without login, e.g. wc2.1_30s_elev.zip (338 MB) and wc2.1_30s_bio.zip (10.4 GB, both HTTP 200). Downscaled CMIP6 future climate is on the same site.
producer: University of California Davis (Fick and Hijmans)
resolution: ~1 km (30 s); also 2.5 m, 5 m, 10 m
direct_download_or_service: https://geodata.ucdavis.edu/climate/worldclim/2_1/base/wc2.1_{10m|5m|2.5m|30s}_{tmin|tmax|tavg|prec|srad|wind|vapr|bio|elev}.zip
gap_or_issue: Climatology only (no time series) and interpolated from sparse stations; licence not stated on the page (check before commercial reuse). Future-climate (CMIP6) page content was not inspected.
usable_for: Climate zoning, agro-climatic suitability and species/crop modelling.

name_en: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 downscaled daily climate projections
description_en: Bias-corrected, statistically downscaled CMIP6 daily temperature (mean/min/max), precipitation, humidity, wind and radiation at 0.25 degrees (~27.8 km) for 1950-2014 (historical) and 2015-2100 under SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5; Earth Engine asset NASA/GDDP-CMIP6, CC0-1.0.
producer: NASA Earth Exchange
direct_download_or_service: GEE asset NASA/GDDP-CMIP6
gap_or_issue: 27.8 km cells give only a handful of grid cells over Armenia; only two scenarios; not the South Caucasus CORDEX regional ensemble, which was not found as an open download. Earth Engine account needed.
usable_for: Future temperature/precipitation scenarios for project risk screening when no national downscaling is available.

name_en: FORACCA / Armhydromet climate indicators for Armenia (36 indicators, community and settlement level)
description_en: Interactive web application by WSL with Armhydromet showing historic values (1991-2020 reanalysis) and future changes for 2031-2060 and 2070-2099 for 36 climate indicators, by RCP or by global warming level (CMIP5 model chains), for individual consolidated communities and for settlements.
producer: Swiss Federal Research Institute WSL (McCarthy, Zilker, Karger) with Armhydromet
direct_download_or_service: Web app https://static.wsl.ch/foracca/ (returns plots per location; no bulk download link found)
gap_or_issue: Viewable without login but no GIS or table download was found; the methods report (data/documentation/report.pdf) says 'Report in progress' and the references page says complete references 'will be added before publication', so treat as a provisional release. Based on CMIP5 chains, not CMIP6. Licence not stated.
usable_for: Only climate-change indicator set found that is already at (consolidated) community level; request the underlying tables from WSL (M. McCarthy, D. Karger) for platform integration.

direct_download_or_service: https://spei.csic.es/spei_database_2_11 (HTTP 200); SPEIbase v2.10 and earlier also in GEE
gap_or_issue: About 50 km pixels - only a few cells cover Armenia; use for national or marz-scale drought history only. Licence not captured from the pages inspected.
usable_for: Drought frequency / severity history for allocating drought-adaptation programmes.

gap_or_issue: Global indicators at coarse resolution; licence and exact service endpoints not inspected. No Armenian-specific drought product.

producer: FAO
year_or_period: Level 1 global; period not stated on the page

name_en: GEM Global Seismic Hazard Map v2026.1 (PGA, 475-year return period)
description_en: GEM's global map of peak ground acceleration with a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years on reference rock (Vs30 800 m/s), collated from national and regional models, with up to 42 layers (PGA and spectral acceleration at 2%, 10%, 50% in 50 years, rock and soil). v2026.1 replaces v2023.1.

gap_or_issue: Zenodo blocked automated access, so the download itself was not tested. Non-commercial/share-alike licence terms. Armenia's own PSHA (below) is more detailed and nationally approved; GEM's Armenia input may derive from it (not verified).

direct_download_or_service: https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search?country=AM (paged JSON); bulk download via GBIF account
gap_or_issue: Spatial and taxonomic bias; coordinates are uncertain for many historical records; not a Red Book distribution dataset. Kingdom counts derive from the GBIF kingdom facet keys (1, 6, 5).
usable_for: Species richness and Red-List species checks near project sites.

sources.title: GBIF occurrence count API, country AM

name_en: Red Book of Armenia species data and the planned national biodiversity database
description_en: The Red Books of animals and of plants/fungi (editions around 2010-2012) are published by the Ministry of Environment and record per-species distribution, but no public distribution-map download was found; the former online version at mnp.am did not resolve. In October 2025 WWF-Armenia held a workshop with the Ministry on an inventory and a national biodiversity database, with a ministry official stating no comprehensive studies have been done since independence.
producer: Ministry of Environment of Armenia; WWF-Armenia
project_or_programme: Red Book of Armenia; WWF-Armenia 'Biodiversity and Sustainable Local Development in Armenia'
gap_or_issue: No machine-readable species distribution layer; the 2010 edition dates come from search-result snippets and were not verified on an opened page; mnp.am (old ministry domain) does not resolve.
usable_for: Species sensitivity screening; needs a data-sharing agreement with the Ministry of Environment.

sources.title: EcoLur - Armenia working on establishment of National Biodiversity Database (Oct 2025)

name_en: GrassAM: Armenia grassland extent, type, above-ground biomass and carrying capacity (DLR / GIZ, 2020)
description_en: Nationwide 10 m maps for 2020 of grassland extent (random forest on Sentinel-1/2 and DEM; overall accuracy 80%), grassland types, green above-ground biomass (R2 0.66) and livestock carrying capacity (optimal stocking 1-3 animals per ha), with field samples collected by ICARE; models still being tested at the time of the poster.
producer: German Aerospace Center (DLR) with GIZ (ICARE field data)
gap_or_issue: Only a conference poster is public (open access); no raster download. A separate Ministry of Economy / GIZ ECOserve project 'Mapping of Pastures and Grasslands in Armenia' (inaugurated 2021-02-10, pilot Lori and Shirak; seen in a search result, page blocked) has no published outputs found. A search result quoted different accuracy figures (R2 0.50) so metrics are preliminary.
usable_for: Pasture area, biomass and stocking capacity per community for pasture-management programmes; request the rasters from DLR / GIZ.

name_en: Pasture degradation assessments (CENS QuickBird study 2017; Syunik Landsat NDVI trends 2000-2021; FAO-GEF ProDoc pasture statistics)
description_en: Academic assessments: Tepanosyan et al. (CENS, 2017) mapped fractional vegetation cover, bare soil and surface rock to grade pasture degradation from QuickBird imagery; Ayvazyan and Asmaryan (CENS, ISPRS 2023) analysed Landsat NDVI seasonal Mann-Kendall trends 2000-2021 for grasslands and pastures in Sisian and Goris (Syunik), finding mostly stable or improving biomass. The FAO-GEF ProDoc reports Syunik has 145,555 ha of natural pastures of 450,542 ha total area (48% community-owned, 52% state-owned).
producer: Centre for Ecological-Noosphere Studies (NAS RA); FAO ProDoc
gap_or_issue: Research outputs only - no downloadable pasture degradation layer; study areas limited (Syunik sites and a QuickBird scene). Whole-country pasture condition mapping by the Ministry of Economy is not published.
usable_for: Evidence base and method for pasture degradation targeting; indicates NDVI trend methods available.

sources.title: Tepanosyan et al. 2017, Remote sensing methods for assessing degradation of Armenia's highland pastures

name_en: Armstat agricultural census 2014 and agriculture / land statistics (ArmStatBank PxWeb)
description_en: ArmStatBank exposes a PxWeb JSON API and Open Data Armenia republishes hundreds of Armstat matrices as CSV/XLSX/JSON-stat (public domain): the 2014 Agricultural Census (holdings by marz, land, irrigation, livestock, machinery), 'Main indicators of agriculture by marzes' (AF-3, 2023 and 2024 versions), land resources by categories and irrigated land (EE-F1) and environment tables (forests D3, protected areas D1, water C1-C7).
producer: Statistical Committee of Armenia (Armstat)
year_or_period: Census reference year 2013-14; annual tables to 2024
resolution: marz level (census also community totals in published tables)
direct_download_or_service: PxWeb API https://statbank.armstat.am/api/v1/en/ArmStatBank (HTTP 200, JSON); CSV copies via https://data.opendata.am/api/3/action/package_search?q=agricultural+census
gap_or_issue: Marz-level only in the tables inspected; no parcel or crop maps. Land balance table source dated 2014. Armstat's main site also has an agricultural-census search system that was not opened.
usable_for: Marz-level baselines of farm numbers, land use and irrigation for targeting programmes.

sources.title: Open Data Armenia - Main Indicators of Agriculture by marzes

name_en: OCHA COD-AB: Armenia subnational administrative boundaries (levels 0-2)
description_en: Common Operational Dataset: Armenia admin 0, 11 provinces (admin 1) and 39 'communities' (admin 2), CC BY-IGO. Dataset date 2023-10-02 to 2024-01-31 (HDX last modified 2026-01-26); 'last edit before publishing 2014-10-01'. Formats: geodatabase, shapefile, GeoJSON zip, XLSX; an edge-matched COD-EM (levels 0-1) also exists. A local copy is already in data/raw/cod_ab.
producer: Government of Armenia (various agencies) via OCHA Field Information Services
direct_download_or_service: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/37b89555-ef3e-4b26-a1ba-070318016853/resource/000c6626-ea37-4618-b0e4-1e4de7e30902/download/arm_admin_boundaries.geojson.zip (scripted fetch returned HTTP 202; links taken from the HDX API)
gap_or_issue: Admin 2 is explicitly 'not an official administrative level' (the 39 units are the old districts, not the ~500 consolidated communities); boundaries date from 2014. No community or settlement level.
usable_for: Marz and district joins (project location gazetteer, statistics).

name_en: geoBoundaries gbOpen: Armenia ADM1 (2005) and ADM2 (2020)
description_en: geoBoundaries open releases for Armenia: ADM1 'Province and City' (11 units, year represented 2005, from Wikimedia, CC BY 2.5) and ADM2 'Municipal Communities' (39 units, year represented 2020, source Government of Armenia / OCHA ROCCA, CC BY 3.0 IGO). Direct GeoJSON/SHP links without login (simplified ADM2 GeoJSON 207 KB, HTTP 200).
producer: William and Mary geoLab (geoBoundaries) from Government of Armenia/OCHA ROCCA
direct_download_or_service: https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09/releaseData/gbOpen/ARM/ADM2/geoBoundaries-ARM-ADM2_simplified.geojson ; API: https://www.geoboundaries.org/api/current/gbOpen/ARM/ADM2/
gap_or_issue: ADM2 is the same 39-unit district layer as OCHA COD; no consolidated-community level. ADM1 derives from a 2005 Wikimedia source.
usable_for: Alternative open admin boundary download with stable API.

name_en: OpenStreetMap extract for Armenia (Geofabrik)
description_en: Daily-updated OpenStreetMap extract for Armenia (shapefile bundle 112.6 MB, last modified 2026-11-04; PBF also offered) with roads, buildings, land use, water, places and administrative boundaries as mapped by volunteers.
producer: OpenStreetMap contributors; extract by Geofabrik
license: ODbL (OpenStreetMap standard licence; not re-read on the Geofabrik page)
direct_download_or_service: https://download.geofabrik.de/asia/armenia-latest-free.shp.zip (redirect, HTTP 200)
gap_or_issue: Community/settlement boundaries in OSM are incomplete and may mix old and consolidated communities; verify before use. Land-use tags are patchy.
usable_for: Settlement points, roads, water and building footprints for accessibility and exposure analysis.

name_en: Armenia administrative community polygons (913 pre-consolidation communities, AUA Acopian Center / Institute of Geological Sciences)
description_en: Polygon shapefile of 913 communities (fields Community_, Arm_Name, CODE; WGS84 UTM 38N) created from a 2008 Armenia geodatabase, republished on Open Data Armenia (uploaded 2023-06-19). REC Caucasus lists a similar 'Community Boundaries of Armenia' layer from the Institute of Geological Sciences built from 1:2000 cadastral data, noting that many community boundaries have been enlarged since 2015 and the data are out of date.
producer: AUA Acopian Center for the Environment (original); Institute of Geological Sciences NAS RA (VGSE) for the cadastral version
resolution: community polygons (1:2000 cadastral source for REC version)
direct_download_or_service: https://data.opendata.am/dataset/667c3f78-0494-4314-b717-9897d44469db/resource/904b79ad-0192-4ab9-892c-763a1a8b539a/download/community_polygons.zip (1.3 MB, downloaded and opened, no login)
gap_or_issue: Pre-2015 community structure (913 polygons) - does not match the current ~500 consolidated communities, so community names/IDs from project documents after 2017 will not join one-to-one. The REC Caucasus ArcGIS FeatureServer for the 1:2000 version returned 'Invalid URL' (removed). Licence not specified.
usable_for: Best openly downloadable community-level geometry; can be dissolved into consolidated communities if a lookup table is obtained.

name_en: Current (consolidated) community boundaries of Armenia, post-2017 amalgamation
description_en: No open download of the current consolidated community boundaries was found. Traces: the National Geoportal (geoportal.am) has a 'community' map layer and thematic 'Administrative boundary' group; its public GeoJSON for marz borders (openlayers/data/marzer.geojson, ~3.9 MB) is downloadable but community_settlement.geojson returns 404; WSL's FORACCA climate web app lists 'Community' (consolidated) and 'Settlement' locations, so those boundaries exist at WSL/Armhydromet.
producer: Cadastre Committee (geoportal.am); Ministry of Territorial Administration and Infrastructure (competent authority, not verified)
gap_or_issue: Not published as an open layer. geoportal.am's WMS (https://geoportal.am/gs/ENV/wms) listed no layers anonymously. Ask the Cadastre Committee or the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Infrastructure for the shapefile with settlement-to-community lookup.
usable_for: Essential for community-level programme mapping; without it, join project communities by name to the 913-polygon pre-consolidation layer.

sources.title: FORACCA Armenia climate indicators web app (community / settlement location types)

name_en: National Geoportal of Armenia (geoportal.am) - Cadastre Committee
description_en: Armenian-language national spatial data infrastructure portal (hy/ru/en) with map viewer and metadata catalogue; thematic groups include administrative boundaries, real estate, addresses, orthophotos, relief, surface water, geographic names, natural disasters, environmental pollution and monitoring, protected areas, geology, plant and animal distribution, climate, forests, agriculture, soils and hydrography. OGC services run on GeoServer (WMS endpoints https://geoportal.am/gs/ENV/wms and /gs/arpis/wms).
producer: Cadastre Committee of Armenia
direct_download_or_service: WMS GetCapabilities https://geoportal.am/gs/ENV/wms?service=WMS&version=1.3.0&request=GetCapabilities returns 200 but an empty layer list anonymously; GetMap for ENV_Climate returned LayerNotDefined
gap_or_issue: Thematic layers appear to need an account (login link on site) or are not exposed anonymously; this was not confirmed with a registered account. The cartographic site maparmenia.am loaded only a 'Loading styles and images' shell. Metadata catalogue pages loaded but listed no records without JavaScript.
usable_for: Authoritative source for cadastral, orthophoto and thematic layers if a data-sharing agreement or account is obtained.

name_en: Open Data Armenia - Data Catalog Armenia (data.opendata.am, CKAN)
description_en: Civil-society CKAN catalogue (Open Data Development Center) that harvests Armenian and international datasets: groups include geospatial (405 datasets), statistics (1,081), environment (28). It mirrors ARMSIS, UNEP GRID Sustainable Caucasus, REC Caucasus, Armstat, HDX and World Bank layers with a full CKAN API.
producer: Open Data Armenia / Open Data Development Center
license: Varies per dataset (CC0, CC BY, public domain, many unspecified)
direct_download_or_service: CKAN API https://data.opendata.am/api/3/action/package_search ; group list https://data.opendata.am/api/3/action/group_list?all_fields=true
gap_or_issue: Many geospatial entries are stale mirrors whose original hosts are down (ARMSIS, UNEP GRID, REC Caucasus ArcGIS), so catalogue presence does not guarantee the file is retrievable; a 2020 EEA-commissioned report said Armenia had no official open data portal and data.gov.am does not resolve.
usable_for: Fastest discovery route for Armenian datasets and licences; also the host of the open community polygons and Sevan monitoring files.

name_en: Legacy GIS hosts: ARMSIS GeoNode (armsis.cas.am) and UNEP GRID 'Sustainable Caucasus' GeoNode
description_en: Two GeoNode platforms originally served many Armenian layers (soils, salinity, SOC, land use, forests, landslides, mudflows, seismic, climate, hydrogeology, canals, protected areas) via OGC WMS/WFS/WCS. ARMSIS (Armenian Soil Information System, ANAU / FAO / GSP) at armsis.cas.am did not resolve in DNS on 2026-11-04; the UNEP GRID site sustainable-caucasus.unepgrid.ch returned a 'Sustainable Caucasus - Under maintenance' page and old download paths returned 404.
producer: ANAU / FAO Global Soil Partnership (ARMSIS); UNEP GRID-Geneva / SCOPES (Sustainable Caucasus)
gap_or_issue: Currently not serving data to us. Contact UNEP GRID-Geneva and ANAU / Centre of the Agricultural Services to recover the layers; check whether the new GeoNode catalogue (#/dataset/...) comes back after maintenance.
usable_for: High-value source of Armenian thematic layers if restored.

sources.title: Open Data Armenia - ARMSIS Soil Map record linking to armsis.cas.am

name_en: Ministry of Environment and subordinate portals (env.am, nature-ic.am, Hydromet, Water Resources Management Agency, Hayantar): data access status
description_en: Status check on 2026-11-04: env.am (Ministry of Environment) loaded but no geodata catalogue was identified; nature-ic.am (UNDP Climate Change Information Platform) loaded and hosts reports (river basin management plan updates, forest inventory strategy 2021) but no GIS downloads; armmonitoring.am returned HTTP 500; meteo.am timed out; wrma.am and forest.am returned 403; hayantar.am had a self-signed certificate; data.gov.am and mnp.am did not resolve.
producer: Ministry of Environment of Armenia and subordinate agencies; UNDP (nature-ic.am)
gap_or_issue: Failures may be blocking of automated clients rather than outages (403s) - retry from a browser. Government data therefore has to be requested formally; no ministry geoportal or open-data feed was identified.
usable_for: Identifies where to send data requests (Ministry of Environment, Hydromet, Water Resources Management Agency, Hayantar).
